rationale: SkiaCanvas::begin_layer compiles its Ganesh offscreen-surface call only when SK_GANESH is defined (the WebGL browser host), matching the guard the image-upload and backend-identity paths already use; native Graphite and raster layer output is unchanged and the link stops keeping Skia's Ganesh backend. In the same range the web-compat JS preludes are embedded as zlib streams and inflated at evaluation (pulp::view::preludes::source); the evaluated text is byte-identical to the .js files, proven per prelude by test, so scripted-UI rendering is unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
